subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Can you make / sure you have / a correct address / before you start driving?
solution:
The correct answer is: **a correct address**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the segment "**a correct address**" lies in the use of the
